screening_aid_disclaimer: SCREENING AID, NOT A DIAGNOSTIC TOOL. This system produces tier-level risk SIGNALS to help prioritise human attention across large volumes of multilingual social-media text. Its outputs are NOT clinical diagnoses and carry no clinical authority. Every flagged case REQUIRES review by a qualified human before any action is taken. The system MUST NOT be used for autonomous decisions affecting individuals.
intended_use: Research into cross-platform, multilingual (Hinglish) mental-health signal detection.
Prioritisation/triage SUPPORT that routes posts to human reviewers — never a substitute for them.
out_of_scope_and_misuse: Clinical diagnosis or any individual clinical labelling.
Automated or involuntary intervention, or any high-stakes decision without human review.
Surveillance, individual targeting, or attempts to de-anonymise users.
Crisis triage in the current pilot-scale form (Tier-3 recall is 0).
human_oversight_vs_P1: P1 ('fully automatic') governs the RESEARCH METHODOLOGY — labelling is automated weak/distant supervision because no clinical experts were available. It does NOT license unsupervised DEPLOYMENT: a deployed system requires mandatory human review (the disclaimer). The two are complementary — automated to BUILD the evidence, human-overseen to ACT on it.

privacy_posture.user_ids: Salted SHA-256 anonymised IDs only; raw usernames are NEVER persisted.
privacy_posture.salt: A stable secret salt (kept out of all artefacts/logs) so IDs are consistent yet non-reversible.
privacy_posture.demographics: No demographic attributes are collected -> no demographic fairness audit is possible (named limitation, not faked).

summary.confound_note: Reddit and Twitter have markedly different class priors (Reddit ~90% Neutral; Twitter balanced across Neutral/Stress/Moderate), so raw macro-F1/accuracy gaps partly reflect dataset composition, NOT solely model bias. The per-Tier recall view (controlling for tier) is the fairer parity lens; it is reported only where true-class support >= 5.

limitations: Crisis (Tier-3) recall = 0.1087 on 46 test posts — the model CANNOT reliably detect crisis at pilot scale; it must NOT be used for crisis triage in its current form.

Neutral-bias: distress posts are frequently misrouted to Neutral (false negatives) — 'Neutral' must NOT be read as 'safe/clear'; the cost of a missed distress case is asymmetric and is the priority for scale-up.
Pilot-scale training (1,971 TRAIN rows) — all numbers are architecture/machinery-validating, not deployable; publishable performance requires the deferred data scale-up + GPU fine-tuning.
No demographic labels were collected (privacy by design) — a demographic fairness audit is NOT possible and is named as future work; only platform parity is computable here.
Explanations are of a pilot-scale model — trigger CONTENT sharpens at scale (Objective 4 caveat).
accountability: Outputs are explainable (notebook 11 multi-method attributions; notebook 12 expert-free clinical face-validity) and auditable (versioned lexicon/anchor/translit tables; seeded, reproducible runs). The unsupportable '85% expert-alignment' claim has been RETIRED (notebook 12); a clinician kappa-study is named future work.
